## Module intents

- **module:agents** — 26 single-purpose reference agents, one directory per agent, each a separate npm package with its own `bin`. 25 of the 26 import `sdk/typescript` for the protocol envelope (the exception is `agents/llm` itself, which the other 9 LLM-backed agents import for the tool loop: coder, planner, reviewer, pr-opener, issue-opener, issue-triage, policy-check, notion-worker, runtime); the rest are mechanical adapters over one vendor API. Each agent observes or acts on ONE task and emits protocol events — routing, retries, loop limits, durable state and webhooks are deliberately the orchestrator's, outside this repo. That boundary is why a per-agent claim says almost nothing: the interesting structure is the fleet, not the members. _(by sol; accepted by sol 2026-08-12)_ — cites `agents/README.md:29`
- **module:agents/issue-triage** — `agents/issue-triage` — imports `agents/llm` (1), `sdk/typescript` (1); reads 3 env vars; exports `triageCommentBody`, `TriageCommentInfo`. _(by cartographer-map; accepted by sol 2026-08-12)_ — cites `agents/issue-triage/src/comment.ts:18`
- **module:agents/llm** — prompts.ts centralizes cross-agent system-prompt rules so wording cannot drift between coder/planner/reviewer/triage: GRAPH_FIRST_RULE mandates using index tools (repo_map, locate_change, impact, find_references) instead of grep for named symbols, and BATCH_TOOL_CALLS_RULE tells agents to issue 3-8 independent tool calls per reply to avoid per-turn round-trip cost. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `agents/llm/src/prompts.ts:1`, `agents/llm/src/prompts.ts:15`, `agents/llm/src/prompts.ts:17`, `agents/llm/src/prompts.ts:27`, `agents/llm/src/prompts.ts:30`
- **module:agents/llm** — `agents/llm` — imported by `agents/runtime` (2), `agents/coder` (1), `agents/issue-opener` (1); reads 18 env vars; exports `IndexStore`, `resolveLlmConfig`, `requestLlmCompletion`, `providerFromLlmConfig`, `runWithLlmTools`. _(by cartographer-map; accepted by sol 2026-08-12)_ — cites `agents/llm/src/tools/symbols/store.ts:185`
- **module:agents/llm** — Model defaults are centralized per agent role in ROLE_DEFAULTS, which gives each role (planner, coder, reviewer, triage, runtime, notion-worker, issue-opener, pr-opener) an anthropic/bedrock/openai model triple; agents pass their row to `resolveLlmConfig` and per-deploy overrides come from `ANCHORAGE_LLM_MODEL` / `ANCHORAGE_<ROLE>_MODEL`. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `agents/llm/src/role-defaults.ts:3`, `agents/llm/src/role-defaults.ts:12`, `agents/llm/src/role-defaults.ts:30`, `agents/llm/src/role-defaults.ts:36`, `agents/llm/src/role-defaults.ts:46`
- **module:agents/llm** — policy.ts implements pure, storage-agnostic architecture governance: it parses `.anchorage/constraints.yaml` with a dependency-free tolerant parser (degrading to zero rules plus warnings on failure) and evaluates `forbid-import` rules against an injected ImportGraphView, with hard violations intended to trigger a code.revision.request between apply-code and run-tests. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:3`, `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:7`, `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:12`, `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:18`, `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:41`, `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:79`, `agents/llm/src/policy.ts:103`
- **module:agents/llm** — The tool loop enforces capability-gated tool exposure and a sandboxed workspace: `runWithTools` takes a workspacePath plus a capabilities list, filters the tool catalog so tools whose capability wasn't granted (e.g. write_file under workspace.write) never reach the provider, emits tool.requested/tool.result events, and returns a snapshot of tool turns and files read. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:3`, `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:28`, `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:32`, `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:71`, `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:76`, `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:100`, `agents/llm/scripts/smoke-tool-loop.mjs:106`
- **module:agents/runtime** — The preview strategy is deliberately isolation-based rather than booting the app: a throwaway Vite harness is written under `<appRoot>/.anchorage/preview/` that imports only the changed components via generated stories and never the app entry point, so it runs without the app's auth/DB/secret dependencies; app fidelity is preserved by reusing the app's PostCSS config, tsconfig path aliases, and a de-duped framework runtime copy. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `agents/runtime/src/harness.ts:1`, `agents/runtime/src/harness.ts:5`, `agents/runtime/src/harness.ts:36`, `agents/runtime/src/harness.ts:48`, `agents/runtime/src/harness.ts:55`, `agents/runtime/src/harness.ts:65`
- **module:agents/runtime** — It owns a pure, I/O-free change classifier that gates the visual preview: docs files are stripped first, any backend/non-UI path signal (api/server/db/migrations dirs, route.ts, .sql/.py/.go, etc.) wins over visual signals, and non-matching changes fall to 'non-visual' — each non-visual kind mapping to a human-readable skip reason so the gate is skipped rather than failing the PR. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:64`, `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:65`, `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:67`, `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:68`, `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:40`, `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:73`, `agents/runtime/src/classify.ts:79`

- **module:cli/anchorage** — OrchestratorClient is the module's single HTTP boundary to the orchestrator: it prefixes every path with the configured serverUrl, sends the secret twice on each request (Authorization: Bearer and X-Orchestrator-Secret, since the server accepts either), and converts fetch failures and non-2xx JSON error bodies into human-readable Error messages. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:127`, `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:132`, `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:139`, `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:149`, `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:152`, `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:156`, `cli/anchorage/src/client.ts:158`
- **module:cli/anchorage** — config.ts owns credential/server resolution with a fixed precedence chain (--server flag > ANCHORAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_URL > ORCHESTRATOR_URL > ~/.config/anchoragelabs/cli.json > https://api.anchoragelabs.dev), deliberately never accepting the secret as a flag, and persists the config file with mode 0600 because it may hold a bearer secret. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `cli/anchorage/src/config.ts:12`, `cli/anchorage/src/config.ts:14`, `cli/anchorage/src/config.ts:34`, `cli/anchorage/src/config.ts:36`, `cli/anchorage/src/config.ts:43`, `cli/anchorage/src/config.ts:53`
- **module:cli/anchorage-runner** — The runner owns no protocol definitions itself: task envelope, agent manifest, event-stream validation, NDJSON parsing, run-manifest building and exit codes are all imported from the shared `@anchorage/sdk` package, making this module a thin orchestration shell over the SDK. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:8`, `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:17`, `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:83`, `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:117`
- **module:cli/anchorage-runner** — The CLI deliberately splits usage output by intent: `--help`/`-h`/`help` prints to stdout and exits 0, while a wrong invocation prints the same usage to stderr and exits non-zero (ExitCode.InvalidInput); this contract is asserted by spawning the built binary in test/help.test.mjs. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:32`, `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:39`, `cli/anchorage-runner/src/index.ts:63`, `cli/anchorage-runner/test/help.test.mjs:30`, `cli/anchorage-runner/test/help.test.mjs:44`, `cli/anchorage-runner/test/help.test.mjs:59`
